s1.desc: a dim bedroom drawn on a plain grey background

spans.view: with a wooden bed with a duck-shaped bedpost, and a phone lying face up on a wooden nightstand in the foreground

beats.text: Pax sleeps on his side under the covers with his head on the pillow, beak open and drooling
Pax reaches a flipper out from under the covers and taps the phone as its screen lights up
Pax tucks his flipper back under the covers and keeps sleeping with his beak open

spans.notes: one locked shot: ECC scale 1.000, 0 px, cc 1.000 every 16 frames; compare 0/128 almost all edges static. Night-time palette (dim, desaturated) for the whole skit, constant: treated as night lighting, not an effect. The phone lies screen-up, so its back can't be seen: is_ifin unsure. Screen glows f65-69, Pax's flipper taps it f67-70. Pax's body is under the covers (head and a flipper show), in the picture: presence full. No overlays
